# croak.lib.civet

import {red} from '@std/fmt/colors'
import {relative} from '@std/path'
import {sprintf} from '@std/fmt/printf'

import {undef, LOG} from 'base-utils'

export let onlyThrow = false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export justThrow := (flag: boolean=true): void =>

	onlyThrow = flag
	return

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type TAssertFunc = (
		cond: unknown,
		msg?: string
		) => asserts cond

export assert: TAssertFunc := (
		cond: unknown,
		msg: string = "An unknown error occurred"
		): asserts cond =>

	if not cond
		croak msg
	return

export obviously: TAssertFunc := (
		cond: unknown
		): asserts cond =>

	if not cond
		croak "obviously not"
	return

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

normalizePath := (path: string): string =>

	newpath := path.replaceAll '\\', '/'
	if (newpath.charAt(1) == ':')
		return newpath.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + newpath.substring(1)
	else
		return newpath

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

relpath := (
		path: string,
		root: string = Deno.cwd()
		): string =>

	return normalizePath relative(root, path)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type TFrameType = (
	'eval' |
	'native' |
	'constructor' |
	'method' |
	'function' |
	'script' |
	'unknown'
	)

export type TStackFrame = {
	i: number
	type: string
	source: string        # relative file path or 'unknown'
	line: number
	col: number
	name: string          # name of function or method
	}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type TFrameFilter = (frame: TStackFrame) => boolean

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export allStackFrames := (
		trace = false
		): Generator<TStackFrame> ->

	try
		# @ts-ignore
		oldLimit := Error.stackTraceLimit
		# @ts-ignore
		oldPreparer := Error.prepareStackTrace
		# @ts-ignore
		Error.stackTraceLimit = 99

		let prevFrame: TStackFrame? = undefined

		# @ts-ignore
		Error.prepareStackTrace = (error, lOrgFrames) =>

			lFrames: TStackFrame[] := for orgFrame,i of lOrgFrames
				fileName := orgFrame.getFileName()
#				console.log "fileName = '#{fileName}'"
				functionName := orgFrame.getFunctionName()
				methodName := orgFrame.getMethodName()
				frame: TStackFrame := {
					i
					type: (
						  orgFrame.isEval()        ? 'eval'
						: orgFrame.isNative()      ? 'native'
						: orgFrame.isConstructor() ? 'constructor'
						: methodName               ? 'method'
						: functionName             ? 'function'
						: orgFrame.isToplevel()    ? 'script'
						:                            'unknown'
						)
					source: fileName ? normalizePath(relpath(fileName)) : ''
					line :  orgFrame.getLineNumber()
					col:    orgFrame.getColumnNumber()
					name:   functionName || methodName || ''
					}

				# --- fix a bug in the V8 engine where calls inside a
				#     top level anonymous function is reported as
				#     being of type 'script'

				if prevFrame
					if (frame.type == 'script') && (prevFrame.type == 'script')
						prevFrame.type = 'function'
						prevFrame.name = '<anon>'

				if trace
					dumpFrame frame, 'ORG FRAME'
				prevFrame = frame
				frame

			return lFrames

		obj: Object := {}
		Error.captureStackTrace(obj)
		# @ts-ignore
		lStack: TStackFrame[] := obj.stack

		# --- reset to previous values
		# @ts-ignore
		Error.stackTraceLimit = oldLimit
		# @ts-ignore
		Error.prepareStackTrace = oldPreparer

		for frame of lStack
			yield frame
		return

	catch err
		console.error "#{red('ERROR:')} #{err}"
		return

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export dumpFrame := (
		frame: TStackFrame,
		label: string = 'FRAME'
		): void =>

	{i, type, source, line, col, name} := frame
	typeStr := sprintf('%-8s', type)
	nameStr := sprintf('%-16s', name)
	if source
		LOG "#{label}[#{i}]: #{typeStr} #{nameStr} #{source}:#{line}:#{col}"
	else
		LOG "#{label}[#{i}]: #{typeStr} #{nameStr} <none>"
	return

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export getMyOutsideCaller := (
	trace: boolean = false
	): TStackFrame? =>

	# --- After skipping all stack frames from this library,
	# --- the next frame will be where this was called from
	#     Save that source and return next frame with a different source

	lFrames := Array.from(allStackFrames())
	let callingSrc: string? = undef
	if trace
		LOG '-'.repeat(70)
		for frame of lFrames
			dumpFrame frame
	for frame of lFrames
		{type, source} := frame
		if (source != 'getMyOutsideCaller')
			continue
		if callingSrc
			if (source != callingSrc)
				return frame
		else
			callingSrc = source

	return undef

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export getErrStr := (err: unknown): string =>

	if (typeof err == 'string')
		return err
	else if (err instanceof Error)
		return err.message
	else
		return "Serious Error"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type TNeverFunc = (err: unknown) => never

export croak: TNeverFunc := (err: unknown): never =>

	errMsg := getErrStr(err)
	if onlyThrow
		# --- allows the error to be caught and handled or ignored
		throw new Error(errMsg)
	else
		console.error red('CROAK') + ': ' + errMsg
		console.error "-----  STACK -----"
		for frame of allStackFrames()
			dumpFrame frame
		Deno.exit()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export TRY := (func: () => void): void =>

	try
		func()
	catch err
		croak err
